hook: Spain's second deadly train crash this year
reel_hook: Two fast trains, one track, 64+ dead

slides.title: Spain high-speed train crash
slides.image_prompt: Empty high-speed railway tracks at dawn stretching across dry Spanish plains, a red signal light glowing, light mist over the rails, sombre muted colours
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
A Renfe AVE hit an Iryo train near Urda, Toledo.
WHY IT MATTERS
At least 64 dead, toll may rise; cause unknown.
FOR YOU
Madrid–Andalusia trains are suspended; check with Renfe or Iryo before travelling.
slides.body: A Renfe AVE hit an Iryo train near Urda, Toledo. At least 64 dead, toll may rise; cause unknown. Madrid–Andalusia trains are suspended; check with Renfe or Iryo before travelling.

slides.title: Israel vote: no clear winner
slides.image_prompt: A ballot box on a wooden table beside two uneven stacks of blank paper ballots, soft window light, neutral background
slides.label: POLITICS
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Netanyahu's bloc leads with about 53–54 seats.
WHY IT MATTERS
A government needs 61 of 120 Knesset seats.
FOR YOU
Results aren't official yet; the shekel and Israeli bonds fell Wednesday.
slides.body: Netanyahu's bloc leads with about 53–54 seats. A government needs 61 of 120 Knesset seats. Results aren't official yet; the shekel and Israeli bonds fell Wednesday.

slides.title: Flávio Bolsonaro leaves Brazil
slides.image_prompt: A small private jet on a night runway, a closed blue passport resting on a suitcase in the foreground, distant city lights
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Lula's defeated rival left despite a court travel ban.
WHY IT MATTERS
He went via Argentina and Ecuador; expected in Miami.
FOR YOU
Not much for you directly: the US says it will grant the family visas.
slides.body: Lula's defeated rival left despite a court travel ban. He went via Argentina and Ecuador; expected in Miami. Not much for you directly: the US says it will grant the family visas.

slides.title: Ebola passes 10,000 cases
slides.image_prompt: A microscope beside neat rows of sealed sample tubes in a clean laboratory, cool blue light, no labels
slides.label: SCIENCE
points: WHAT HAPPENED
DR Congo figures show 10,060 confirmed Ebola cases.
WHY IT MATTERS
Fastest-growing on record; this strain has no approved vaccine.
FOR YOU
If travelling to DR Congo or neighbouring countries, check official health advice first.
slides.body: DR Congo figures show 10,060 confirmed Ebola cases. Fastest-growing on record; this strain has no approved vaccine. If travelling to DR Congo or neighbouring countries, check official health advice first.

slides.title: World's longest freight train?
slides.image_prompt: An extremely long freight train of empty ore wagons curving across dry semi-desert plains under a wide blue sky, vanishing toward the horizon
slides.label: CURIOSITY
points: WHAT HAPPENED
South Africa's Transnet says it ran a 696-wagon train.
WHY IT MATTERS
That would beat BHP's 2001 record of 682 wagons.
FOR YOU
Just a fun fact: it stretched 7.6 km over an 860 km trip.
slides.body: South Africa's Transnet says it ran a 696-wagon train. That would beat BHP's 2001 record of 682 wagons. Just a fun fact: it stretched 7.6 km over an 860 km trip.

caption:
🚆 Spain: at least 64 dead after two high-speed trains collided near Urda, toll may rise. Madrid–Andalusia trains are suspended, so check before you travel.
🗳️ Israel: Netanyahu's bloc leads with about 53–54 seats, short of the 61 needed. Results aren't official yet.
✈️ Brazil: Flávio Bolsonaro left despite a court travel ban and is expected in Miami.
🦠 Ebola passes 10,000 confirmed cases. Travelling to DR Congo or nearby? Check health advice.
🚂 South Africa says it ran a 7.6 km freight train, a claimed world record.
